{{Coins|1,020}} & {{Exp|204}} (Insane) |music-1 = See [[#Soundtrack]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== Before the [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]], there were four main modes, these being the '''Easy''', '''Normal''', '''Hard''' and '''Insane''' modes. As these modes were nearly identical, with only the wave amount, wave bonus and wave cash being different, they were combined into one page on the wiki. In '''Pre-MEGA''' modes, shared cash was calculated as Damage ÷ Players. For example, if someone else damaged an enemy by 10 health in a server with two people, you would receive {{Money|5}}. However, in a server with three people, you would receive {{Money|3}}. Before the 5th of August 2019, there was only one mode which had 56 waves; as it was not given a name, it will be referred to as '''Pre-MEGA''' mode. ==Rewards== The game calculated how much {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Exp|}} you received based on how many waves you survived.
